item.title: Virgins Announce Break Up, New Single, EP and Farewell Show
item.description: Virgins announce new single, a new EP and at the same time the end of the band and a farewell show. The band spent the last months of 2025 recording new material in their practice space, the results of which we hear on the new single, ‘Crucible’ out January 22nd and the following EP ‘Light The Space Left Behind’ out February 19th. item.title: The Hara // The Fallout // Album Review
item.description: 9Manchester trio The Hara are set to release their second full-length album on the 23rd January, and it is a serious eye-opener. “Trophy” opens the album with Taylor’s pleading vocals before it bursts into life with a thunderous drum beat and chugging riffs, which then drops back to a slow beat as Taylor delivers a sombre verse before exploding at the chorus.
